macros.name: savedate
macros.doc: \savedate takes a single argument, the name you’d like to give your saved date.

macros.name: setdateformat
macros.doc: The macro \setdateformat holds the formatting string for the date.

macros.name: texdatenumformat
macros.doc: Any command which will work on a TeX count register can be inserted into the \texdatenumformat command, which will be applied to all the numbers which texdate outputs.

macros.name: texdcalyear
macros.doc: \texdcalyear will produce one of these calendars for an entire year, in three columns; the year chosen is the argument given to the macro.
